reviews.comments: This small lamp is everything I wanted it to be, small so I have space to stack books on my nightstand. The shade is much brighter colors than shown. The rocker switch is close to the lamp so you don't have to lean way out of bed to use it. Nice natural wood base. Easy to assemble, good thick cord. I am pleased with it. Light is bright during the day and at night great for reading or looking at the clock at the 3 am wakeful hour.

Absolutely love this lamp! It’s surprisingly very bright for how small it is. It came with a light bulb (soft white) and was easy to assemble. The cord is nice and long, too. Perfect for my coffee bar!
Really like the lamp, perfect for my beside table. Not to bright, just right. Perfect size. Hang on and off switch. Very nice looking.

I’m a brown person and this warm lighting makes my skin look so healthy. It’s super bright which is surprising because it’s such a small bulb, and the quality is so great that I often forget at how cheap I got it for. I recommend this to anyone who wants a small lamp in their bedroom who’s looking to cut budget corners.

I just had a little bit of trouble putting it together at first. It is pretty light weight. Sadly, there is just an on and off switch and I wish it was on the lamp itself because I ran the cord underneath my desk so it is a bit hidden now. I really like it and will probably buy another one soon.

This is a solid, inexpensive choice if you want to give a kid’s bedroom a simple, mid-century modern touch. The 9" size works perfectly for small spaces, and the warm 3000K LED bulb creates a cozy glow without being harsh. It’s bright enough (680 lumens) to light up the whole room, but still soft thanks to the linen shade. Assembly took less than a minute — just attach the shade, screw in the included bulb, and plug it in. It is quite small-- a nice size for a small side table, bookshelf or (like mine) on a mantle. I like that it comes with a cord and outlet plug, plus it has an easy on/off switch near the top of the cord.
